columns.text: "Creation eagerly awaits the revealing of the sons of God" Rom 8:19-21

The sons of God, are first mentioned in the Old Testament. Who were those sons of God? Job 38:3-7 Why is creation still waiting for the sons of God? Rom 8:19-21 This is the story of Yahweh’s two families, the heavenly sons of God and the earthly sons of God. .

pages.title: God dwells with His Families
pages.description:
The story of what is happening behind the scenes of Creation - from Genesis to Revelation.

Understand passages there were a little strange instead of passing over them.  You will see and understand the bible like you never did before.

As you read this story, the Word of God will open up next to it with a single click or tap.

columns.text: Before everything existed, God wanted to dwell with a human family forever. 1 He wanted so many people in His family that His plan would take thousands of years to complete.  God already had a spiritual family in heaven and needed a special place where they could live as one with Him. 2
1 Eph 1:3-5 2 Eph 3:14-15

So God created a planet especially suited for both humans and spiritual beings. His heavenly family rejoiced as they watched. 1  He surrounded it with myriads of galaxies which could be seen from earth.  God knew that everyone would be able to look up and see His infinite power and glory. 1  God called the planet earth and filled it with all kinds of animals for the land, sea and sky.  He gave it climates to grow all kinds of beautiful plants and tasty food. 2
1 Job 38:4-7

So having created the earth God created Adam and Eve, male and female so they could multiply and fill the earth.  They would be the ambassadors of the heavenly realm on earth, made in their image and likeness — reigning on earth, according to God's Word. 1  After ushering in God’s Kingdom, with the help of His heavenly family, Earth would become the Paradise of God, where heaven and earth come together.

As Yahweh finished creating the earth, His heavenly family rejoiced in heaven. Then He planted a garden for Adam and Eve, called Eden, the Paradise of God, where they walked with Him. There was the tree of life in the midst of the garden and everything was very good.

Yahweh knew His holiness was too high for mankind to meet, so would not be able to stay in His presence. However, He had already planned that a descendant of Eve would make a way for mankind to live with Him. That promise is true — and eternal.

Yahweh told Adam and Eve they could eat from every tree of the garden but one. Eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and in that day you die.Then a serpent came with a different word. He asked if God had really said that, and promised they would not die — they would be like God. The woman looked at the tree.

columns.title: Why did God create the universe?
columns.text: God wanted mankind to recognise His power over all creation and His love for the world. :::details 1. God demonstrates His infinite power to all mankind every day.  2. No one has an excuse for not acknowledging God and being grateful for His creation and for being created in the first place. Psa 19:1-4 Rom 1:20-21

columns.title: Why did God create mankind?
columns.text: God wants mankind to know Him so that He can dwell with His human family forever. :::details God wants mankind to know that He is Yahweh, God Almighty.  He loves the world and gave His only begotten Son that they might have eternal life with Him. Jer 24:7 Jhn 3:16-17
